Photos.Caption: 2020 Spirit II E-310 (L) and our beloved 1999 Spirit series 700 (R).  Hope the new one lasts another 20+ years!!

Results.ReviewText:
We decided it was time to bid farewell to our TWENTY ONE year old Weber grill this week - and after looking at many other brands and models, we ultimately decided to replace it with the new version (Spirit II E-310) of the same model (Spirit II 700 series). Why mess with success??

My late husband and I bought our Spirit 700 series to cook on while we were renovating our kitchen in 1999 and I’ve cooked on it year-around ever since. I’ve replaced the grates, the ‘flavorizer bars,’ the regulator hose, and we’ve been using stick lighters for years (the ignition failed long ago) - but when the bottom rotted out, we knew its time had come. Webbie ended up ‘costing’ about $2 a month over 21 years. Not so bad.

We've cooked meals on the new grill every night since getting it, and it's every bit as wonderful as the old one, if not better!  I highly recommend Weber grills!!
Results.Title: Tried and true.  Why mess with success?!

Results.OriginalProductName: Spirit II E-310 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
Results.ReviewText: I am NOT one of those guys that is SUPER passionate about grilling! I am a guy that likes things that work well and require low maintenance which is why I wanted this grill. My wife purchased this for me for Father's Day after asking me if this was a "good one." There is nothing that I don't like about this grill so far!!!! Even heat distribution and everything appears to be made of high quality materials. I am slightly nervous about the porcelain enameled cast iron grates, but I don't see many negative reviews from people indicating a problem with them. Like anything I have a hunch being responsible and cleaning and maintaining it is the primary way to extend its lifespan. That being said, the warranty does give me some confidence. I also recommend grabbing an iGrill for this as well as it just completes the whole package to make grilling a joy again for the average guy!
Results.Title: An Average Guy's Perspective - Not BBQ Obsessive

Results.OriginalProductName: Spirit II E-310 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
Results.ReviewText:
Upgraded from a Q2200 to this Spirit II.  The Q was amazing, but I needed more power/cooking space.  The Spirit II is a great choice, it has enough space to cook for a small party, and by adding the rotisserie attachment I’ve been able to make amazing meals (recently made a 17 pound prime rib - it was perfection).  

The grill has the perfect size for my balcony, and it is easy to clean (even easier than the Q).  Temperature is maintained consistently throughout the grill ensuring that all everything you cook is ready at the same time.  

Very good grill overall, at a very affordable price.
Results.Title: Great upgrade

ClientResponses.Response:
Hello, thank you for taking your time to submit your feedback! We are very sorry to hear about your experience with your grill! We do not expect your food to be sticking to the grates. When grilling please be sure to preheat your grill at high for about 15 to 20 minutes before placing your food on the grate. After few uses, your grill grates will be seasoned and you should not have any issues. If you would like you can oil your meat for the first few uses. For simple easy clean be sure to use a stainless steel brush while your grill is hot. 

We expect our grills to have evenly distributed heat across the grilling surface. When your grill is cooled down remove the grill grates and flavorizer bars and start your grill. Your burners should have nice and even flames all across. Always make sure that you are cooking with your lid closed and only open the lid when it is time to flip your food. 

We want to let you know that your grill parts are backed by ten year warranty. If you have any questions or need assistance with anything, please do not hesitate to reach out to our support team. We will be happy to help and we thank you for choosing Weber!
ClientResponses.Name: WeberGrills

Results.ReviewText:
This excellent grill was surprise gifted me, by my daughters, on my birthday I have been without a grill for 5 long years.

After unboxing, then using the online app, assembly took about an hour and fifteen minutes. It heats up incredibly fast...550f in less than 15 minutes. Cooking on it is a pleasure. Some practice with temperature control will allow keeping temperatures as low as about 215f (as read on the built in thermometer.) My experience with grils is that is an approximate reading, as the actual reading is usually maybe 15-20f cooler. I haven't noticed any particularly cooler spots on the grill, though overall, at least for me, the rear 2/erds of the grill seem a wee bit hotter.

The starter works as advertised. BTW, I would heartily recommend a full 20# tank, not the tanks sold at the big box stores. Mine is from U-Hall, has a gauge on it which visually lets you know about how much propane remains. They are $35, plus filling. No more than the ones sold at the other places. 

It's a Weber, and works like one, from build quality to features. I have yet to use the smart bluetooth thermometer hookup as yet. That will be a Christmas present to myself!!

I heartily recommend the Spirit 2 E-300 as an all around fine grill.
Results.Title: Happily grilling once more!

ClientResponses.Response:
Hello, we are very sorry to hear about this issue. We would be happy to help you with this. Flare ups are a byproduct of grilling over live fire. The drippings falling down create the flare ups. While they can never be eliminated completely, below are some steps for reducing them:



1. Cleaning your grill. I recommend cleaning your cooking grates, Flavorizer bars, burner tubes, heat deflectors (if applicable), the inside of your cookbox, and your slide out grease tray.



2. If using a marinade, get as much excess liquid off as possible before putting the food on the grill.



3. If using a sauce, wait until the last 5-10 minutes to apply. If you have further questions please contact or support team. Thanks!

Results.ReviewText:
I like the grill a lot.  The thermometer pegged at 650+ F on the initial burn in (I haven't needed it to get that hot since).  I was one of the unlucky few whose grill arrived without the hardware package but Weber overnighted them to me at no charge.  Can't ask for better customer service!

What I don;t like are the wheels and axle.  The axle is about 1/2" too long and the wheels wobble and tilt.  Trying to move it across a flat smooth surface, one wheel is rolling straight and the other is trying to make a turn.  It's not the same wheel that tilts every time, but every time I move it, one of them tilts.

I'll get around to finding the proper nylon washers to get the proper fit, but it was a disappointent on an otherwise flawless grills.
